local function findClosureByNameAndConstants(scriptObject, targetFuncName, upvalueIndex, constantsSignature)
    for _, func in ipairs(getgc(true)) do

            local info = debug.getinfo(func)

            if info.name == targetFuncName and info.source:find(scriptObject.Name) then

                local match = true

                for i, v in pairs(constantsSignature) do
                    if constants[i] ~= v then
                        match = false
                        break
                    end
                end

                if match then
                    return func
                end
            end

end
